info.title: OpenAlgo REST API
info.description: OpenAlgo v1 REST API. Derived from the OpenAlgo documentation (docs/api) and request schemas (restx_api). The apikey is injected by the CLI and therefore omitted from every operation.

post.description: Return whether analyzer (sandbox) mode is active and how many simulated orders have been logged.
Switch analyzer (sandbox) mode on or off application-wide. Disabling it means subsequent orders go to the live broker with real money; blocked in semi-auto order mode.
Place multiple independent orders in one request; BUY orders are processed before SELL orders. Partial success is possible and each order reports its own status.
Destructive bulk operation that cancels every open and trigger-pending order in the account. Returns success even if some cancellations fail.
Cancel an active GTT trigger by its id; cancelling an OCO removes both legs atomically. Only active triggers can be cancelled.
Cancel a specific open or pending order by its order id. Completed orders cannot be cancelled.

get.description: Return all stored chart workspace preferences for the API key.

post.description: Upsert arbitrary chart preference keys for the API key. At least one and at most 50 keys, each key up to 50 characters and each JSON value up to 1 MiB.
Destructive operation that squares off every open position across all exchanges using MARKET orders with the same product type. There is no confirmation step.

post.summary: Get market depth for a symbol
post.description: Returns a single snapshot of market depth (top 5 bids and asks) with OHLC and volume for a symbol. Use 'openalgo stream depth' for continuous updates.
Return available expiry dates for a futures or options underlying, sorted nearest first in DD-MMM-YY format.
Returns available cash, collateral, realized and unrealized M2M and utilized margin for the connected broker account. Values are strings for some live brokers and numbers in analyzer mode.
List the user's GTT triggers, active only by default. Send status all to include triggered, cancelled, expired and rejected history.
Returns historical OHLCV candles for a symbol between two dates. Data availability and supported intervals depend on the broker; use source db to read locally stored Historify data.
Returns delivery holdings with per-holding P&L and portfolio statistics.

get.description: Download the locally stored instrument master for all exchanges or one exchange. With format=csv the response is a text/csv file download instead of JSON.

parameters.name: exchange
parameters.description: exchange to filter by; current OpenAlgo servers reject a request without it

post.description: Returns the historical data intervals supported by the connected broker, grouped by unit.

post.summary: Calculate margin for a basket of positions
post.description: Calculates the margin required for a basket of 1 to 50 positions, including hedging benefits where the broker supports it. Not all brokers support margin calculation.
Returns market holidays for a year, including exchanges closed and exchanges running special sessions. Defaults to the current year.

post.summary: Get market timings for a date
post.description: Returns trading session start and end times per exchange for a date, in epoch milliseconds. Returns an empty array on weekends and full holidays.
Fully replace the spec of an active GTT trigger; omitted fields are not preserved. Trigger type, symbol, exchange and action cannot change, and Semi-Auto mode blocks this call.
Modify price, quantity, trigger price or price type of an open or pending order. All fields are required even when unchanged.
Calculate Black-76 implied volatility and Greeks for 1 to 50 options in one batch. Individual items can fail while the batch succeeds, so inspect each item and the summary.
Returns real-time quotes for several symbols in one call. Symbols that fail lookup are returned with an error field instead of data.

post.summary: Get the open position for a symbol
post.description: Return the net open quantity for a symbol, exchange and product combination, or 0 when flat.
Return the option chain for an underlying and expiry with quotes for each strike, optionally with Black-76 implied volatility and Greeks per leg at no extra broker calls.
Calculate Black-76 implied volatility and Greeks for one option. The forward defaults to a per-expiry synthetic future, falling back to the underlying quote.
Place 1 to 20 option legs sharing a common underlying, each resolved from its strike offset. BUY legs execute before SELL legs and a failed leg does not stop later legs.

post.summary: Place an options order by strike offset
post.description: Resolve an option symbol from the underlying, expiry and ATM/ITM/OTM offset, then place the order. Index underlyings are placed on NFO or BFO; splitsize greater than 0 returns per-child results.
Resolve the option symbol for an underlying, expiry, strike offset (ATM, ITMn, OTMn) and option type using actual strikes from the master contract.
Returns all orders placed during the current trading day, including completed, cancelled and rejected orders, along with summary statistics.

post.summary: Get the status of an order
post.description: Return the current details and status of a specific order by its order id.
Verify that the API key resolves to an active broker session. Not an anonymous health check; an invalid key or missing broker session returns HTTP 403.

Place a Good Till Triggered order that fires a child order when LTP crosses the trigger. OCO requires triggerprice_sl, stoploss, triggerprice_tg and target with triggerprice_sl below triggerprice_tg; on Upstox an OCO opens a position at market first.

200.description: GTT placement result with trigger id

post.description: Place a new order with the broker. In analyzer mode the order is routed to the sandbox and the response carries a mode field.
Place an order sized to move the current open position for the symbol to the requested position_size. No order is placed if the position already matches.
Return today's realized and unrealized P&L per open sandbox position. Available only while analyzer mode is enabled; live mode returns HTTP 400.
Returns all positions for the trading day, including closed positions with zero quantity. Positive quantity is long, negative is short.

post.summary: Get a quote for a symbol
post.description: Returns a real-time quote for a single symbol including OHLC, LTP, bid, ask and volume.
Search the master contract for symbols matching a free-text query such as name, strike, month and option type. Search is case-insensitive and results are limited.

post.summary: Split a large order into smaller orders
post.description: Place a large quantity as sequential child orders of splitsize each, with the remainder in the last order. At most 100 child orders are allowed per request.

post.summary: Close all legs of a strategy run
post.description: Same mechanics as stop, but first records a close_all_manual audit event. Exits every owned position at market and finalises only after confirmed flatness.

post.summary: Close one leg of a strategy run
post.description: Exit one leg of the current run at market while the run continues with the rest. A leg that is not open returns 409.
Return the append-only risk-event audit trail for a strategy, newest first. Out-of-vocabulary kind or severity, or limit outside 1 to 1000, is a 400.
List the strategies owned by this API key, newest first. The list form omits legs; an out-of-vocabulary status filter is a 400.
Return every order the engine placed across a strategy's runs, oldest first, optionally narrowed to one run. A run_id from another strategy matches nothing.
Return every activation of a strategy, newest first. limit outside 1 to 500 is a 400 rather than being clamped.

Start a run of a batch strategy and place every leg's entry order. mode is required with no default; live is refused with 409 unless live trading is enabled on the strategy. Signal strategies cannot be started and return 400.

post.summary: Get one strategy's configuration and current run
post.description: Return one strategy's full configuration including legs, plus its current run or null. A strategy that is not yours returns 404 Strategy not found.

Persist a stop request, exit every owned position at market, and finalise the current run only once fills confirm it is flat. Returns 409 when the strategy is not running or the broker refused the exits.
Return master-contract details for a single symbol, including the broker-specific symbol, token, lot size and tick size.
Calculate the synthetic futures price from ATM call and put premiums via put-call parity. Does not place any orders.

Validate and broadcast a message to linked users. Delivery is not yet implemented server-side, so success_count and fail_count are currently always 0. Limited to 5 requests per minute; returns 403 when broadcast is disabled.

get.description: Return the Telegram bot configuration with bot_token truncated to its first 10 characters.

post.description: Update the supplied Telegram bot configuration fields; omitted fields are left unchanged.

post.summary: Send a Telegram notification to one user
post.description: Send a message to one OpenAlgo user linked to Telegram. By default it is queued and HTTP 200 means queued, not delivered. Returns 409 when the bot is stopped and 404 when the user is not linked.

get.description: Return notification preferences for a Telegram user; defaults are returned when none are stored.

post.description: Update the supplied notification preferences for a Telegram user; omitted fields are left unchanged.
Initialize and start the Telegram bot from the stored configuration. Returns 400 when no bot token is configured.

get.description: Return Telegram bot command statistics for the last N days.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: look-back window in days, clamped to 1 to 365

post.description: Stop the Telegram bot service. Automatic order and Flow alerts are suppressed while the bot is stopped.

get.description: List active Telegram users linked to OpenAlgo, optionally filtered by broker or notification setting.

parameters.name: notifications_enabled
parameters.description: filter by notification setting; the string true matches enabled, anything else disabled

get.description: Returns broker historical candles for an EXCHANGE:SYMBOL path in JSON or plain text (format txt). The date range is capped to 30 days for intraday intervals and 10 years for D, W and M; data is always read from the broker API.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: exchange and symbol separated by one colon, e.g. NSE:RELIANCE

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: response format: json or txt (comma-separated plain text rows)

200.description: Successful response (JSON form; format txt returns text/plain rows)

post.description: Returns all executed trades for the current trading day. A single order may appear multiple times when it was partially filled.

Send text, an image or a document to exactly one recipient form: self, username, phone, or up to 5 phones. Returns 409 when WhatsApp is not paired or connected. With wait_for_delivery, a send that reached nobody returns HTTP 200 with status error and the delivery report.

error.description: rejection reason when ok is false

id.description: strategy id, used as strategy_id on every other strategy endpoint

universe_tab.description: instrument universe the strategy was built from

underlying_exchange.description: exchange the underlying is quoted on

product.description: configured product intent (MIS intraday, anything else carry)

overall_sl_mtm.description: strategy-level stop loss in rupees of MTM

overall_target_mtm.description: strategy-level target in rupees of MTM

mode.description: lock profit mode, e.g. lock_and_trail

if_profit_reaches.description: profit level that arms the lock

trail_step.description: step by which the locked floor trails

trail_sl_to_entry.description: whether a stop on one leg trails the others to entry

enabled.description: whether the built-in scheduler is enabled

days.description: weekdays the scheduler runs on, e.g. MON

auto_stop_time.description: IST auto stop time as HH:MM

live_enabled.description: whether this strategy may run in live mode

webhook_locked.description: whether the webhook kill switch is engaged

webhook_ip_allowlist.description: CIDR ranges allowed to trigger the webhook

current_run_id.description: the run this strategy is executing, if any

items.description: leg configuration as saved by the wizard

position.description: B for buy or S for sell

option_type.description: CE or PE for option legs

atm_offset.description: strike offset from ATM, e.g. ATM

risk_unit.description: unit for sl_pts, target_pts and trail

x.description: move required to advance the trail

run.description: current run, or null when not running

id.description: run id, usable as run_id on orders and events

mode.description: run mode, fixed for the life of the run

broker.description: broker the run is bound to, sandbox for a sandbox run

stopped_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC stop time, null while the run is open

stop_reason.description: why the run ended, null while open

stop_requested_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time a durable stop was requested, null when none is pending

stop_requested_reason.description: reason for a pending stop; while set new signal entries are gated

pnl_realized.description: realized P&L written at confirmed-flat finalization

webhook_event_id.description: inbound webhook event that started the run, when one did

resolved_expiries.description: leg id (as string) to the expiry resolved at run start

run_id.description: the run the stop applies to; it stays current while stop_pending is true

stop_pending.description: true while owned exposure still needs a fill, retry or reconciliation; false only once flatness was confirmed

leg_id.description: the leg's id within the strategy

ok.description: whether the exit order was accepted

position_ref.description: exact durable owner the exit targets

symbol.description: held symbol, included when an unfilled entry is refused before dispatch

error.description: rejection reason when ok is false

message.description: message to broadcast, at most 4096 characters

success_count.description: number of users the broadcast reached

fail_count.description: number of users the broadcast failed for

bot_token.description: bot token, truncated to the first 10 characters followed by an ellipsis

token.description: backward-compatible alias of the bot token

is_active.description: whether the bot is active; stopping it suppresses automatic alerts

rate_limit_per_minute.description: bot message rate limit per minute

username.description: OpenAlgo username linked to a Telegram id

priority.description: priority from 1 to 10; out-of-range values fall back to 5

wait_for_delivery.description: wait for an immediate delivery attempt instead of queueing

polling_mode.description: use polling mode instead of webhook mode

total_commands.description: total commands executed in the period

top_users.description: up to 10 most active users as [telegram_username, command_count] pairs

items.description: pair of telegram username and command count

last_command_at.description: time of the user's last bot command

mode.description: true to enable analyzer mode, false to switch to live

analyze_mode.description: true if analyzer mode is active

mode.description: current mode

total_logs.description: number of orders logged in analyzer mode

self.description: send to the paired device's own number

username.description: OpenAlgo username resolved through the linked-users table or the paired owner

phones.description: up to 5 E.164 digit strings; entries beyond 5 are dropped

message.description: text body, at most 4096 characters; optional if image_path or document_path is set

image_path.description: server-local path to an image file inside the attachment allowlist

document_path.description: server-local path to a document file inside the attachment allowlist

caption.description: caption for the image, or follow-up text for a document

wait_for_delivery.description: block until the send completes and return a per-recipient report; false queues and returns immediately

queued.description: number of recipients dispatched to the alert pool, present when wait_for_delivery is false

data.description: per-recipient delivery report, present when wait_for_delivery is true

sent.description: JIDs the send was accepted for
